q1.question: What is LTX-2 text to video and how does it work?
q1.answer: LTX-2 text to video is Lightricks' next-generation open-source AI video foundation model that converts text prompts into high-quality videos. It uses a DiT (Diffusion-Transformer) hybrid architecture with space-time modeling to generate high-fidelity videos from text descriptions. The LTX-2 text to video model creates synchronized audio and video in a single pass, eliminating the need for separate audio stitching or manual syncing. LTX-2 text to video supports native 4K resolution at up to 50 FPS with clips up to 20 seconds long.

q2.question: Is LTX-2 text to video generator free to use?
q2.answer: Yes, our LTX-2 text to video generator offers free access for basic video generation. The underlying LTX 2 model is fully open-source with complete model weights available on GitHub and Hugging Face. For higher resolution (4K), longer durations, and commercial use, premium plans are available with additional features and priority processing.

q3.question: What resolution and quality can LTX-2 text to video generate?
q3.answer: LTX-2 text to video supports multiple resolutions including 720p HD, 1080p Full HD, 1440p QHD, and native 4K Ultra HD (3840×2160). The LTX-2 text to video model can generate videos at frame rates up to 50 FPS, delivering smooth cinematic motion. Maximum video duration is 20 seconds of continuous synchronized audio-video generation.

q4.question: Can I use LTX-2 with ComfyUI locally?
q4.answer: Yes! LTX-2 has native ComfyUI integration. You can download the model weights from Hugging Face and use them with ComfyUI-LTXVideo nodes for local generation. For optimal performance, NVIDIA recommends 12GB+ VRAM for 720p/1080p and 24GB+ for 4K generation. The model supports NVFP8 quantization for reduced memory usage and faster inference on RTX GPUs.

q5.question: What GPU and VRAM do I need to run LTX-2 locally?
q5.answer: Minimum requirements: 12GB VRAM for 720p-1080p at 24-30 FPS. Recommended: 16-24GB VRAM (RTX 4080, RTX 3090) for comfortable 1080p-1440p generation. Ideal: 24GB+ VRAM (RTX 4090, RTX 5090) for native 4K at 50 FPS. NVIDIA has optimized NVFP8 weights that reduce VRAM by 40% and improve performance by 2x on RTX 40/50 series GPUs.

q6.question: How does LTX-2 text to video compare to other AI video generators?
q6.answer: LTX-2 text to video is the first open-source model combining synchronized audio-video generation, native 4K resolution, and 50 FPS in one system. Compared to Runway, Pika, and Kling, LTX-2 text to video offers up to 50% lower compute costs and full open-source transparency. It excels in visual fidelity and runs efficiently on consumer GPUs, making professional text to video creation accessible to independent creators.

q7.question: Can I train custom LoRA models with LTX-2?
q7.answer: Yes! LTX-2 supports LoRA fine-tuning for custom styles, motion patterns, and character likeness. Training for motion, style, or likeness can take less than an hour in many settings. The LTX-2 Trainer provides comprehensive documentation for full fine-tuning, LoRA training, and IC-LoRA (Identity-Consistent LoRA) workflows.
